subject: Pilot top-up request — short-term credit to lock Q3 expansion
messages:
From: Alex Park <apark@atlasai.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lowe <jlowe@atlasai.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot top-up — short note

Hi Connor,

Quick update from our side: the AtlasAI team is very close to finishing the evaluation — model quality and latency both look good in our tests. Our remaining blocker is coverage: we hit the token allotment for the trial last week and the team needs a small extension/top-up to complete the final 2 use cases (analytics export + realtime classification).

Is there any flexibility on a short, one-off credit or a 30–45 day trial extension? If we can get that, we can finish validation next week and present a recommended budget for a Q3 paid rollout.

I attached a short usage extract (pilot_usage_report.csv) that shows the consumption pattern.

Thanks — Alex

--
Alex Park
Head of Platform, AtlasAI
apark@atlasai.com
From: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot top-up — short note

Team — forwarding Alex's ask. TL;DR: AtlasAI needs a small token top-up or a 30–45 day extension to complete the pilot; strong chance to convert to paid Q3 (they've signaled a $75k ARR initial commit).

Proposal for quick approval:
- One-time platform credit = $5,000 (applied to invoice or as billing credit) OR
- 45-day trial extension + 60k token top-up (equivalent cost)

Why I recommend this:
- Close probability this quarter > 70% if they can finish validation
- Pilot shows low error/latency issues, just need runway
- Small credit vs. expected ARR and negligible churn risk

Attachments: pilot_usage_report.csv (consumption breakdown). HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1873

Can Finance/Revenue ops sign off quickly? Laura — want to loop you for manager OK. Marissa — can you own the success plan if we approve?

Thanks,
Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2026 18:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot top-up — short note

Connor — thanks for the context and the HubSpot link. A couple of quick asks from finance before I can greenlight:

1) Can we cap the one-time credit at $4,500? If they sign PO / MPA within 60 days, we can treat the credit as a first-invoice credit; otherwise it is a promotional credit.
2) Please include a one-paragraph commercial justification (expected ARR, timing, and next steps) so I can record the uplift in our discount ledger.
3) Request Marissa to confirm a success plan milestone that triggers the formal conversion (e.g., production readiness checklist + executive sponsor meeting).

Structurally I'd prefer we issue a billing credit (platform credit) vs. discount on invoice to make accounting tidy.

-Rafael
Director, Revenue Operations
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot top-up — short note

OK — approvable with conditions.

Decision: Approve up to $5,000 platform credit OR a 45-day trial extension, conditional on:
- Signed MPA addendum or PO within 60 days (attach mpa-addendum-draft.pdf to the customer email)
- A clear success plan owned by Marissa with two measurable milestones (completion of analytics export test, and realtime classification stability at 99% availability)
- Finance to record credit as first-invoice credit if conversion happens within the 60d window (Rafael, please confirm accounting treatment).

Connor: send the formal offer to Alex today with the two options and the MPA addendum attached. Marissa: please draft the two milestone deliverables and timeline — Connor should copy AtlasAI execs.

Laura Bennett
Sales Manager — West Region, Redwood Inference
From: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <apark@atlasai.com>, Jordan Lowe <jlowe@atlasai.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot top-up — short note

Alex / Jordan — thanks for the quick note and for the usage extract. We can help you finish validation this week. Please see the two options we can offer:

Option A — Platform credit (recommended)- One-time $5,000 billing credit applied to your first invoice if AtlasAI signs MPA/PO within 60 days.
- Credit will be visible in the billing portal and applied at invoice time.

Option B — Trial extension + token top-up- 45-day extension on the current trial + 60k token top-up to cover the remaining test runs.

Conditions (both options):
- Sign MPA addendum or PO within 60 days (attached: mpa-addendum-draft.pdf)
- Success plan with two milestones owned by our CS lead (Marissa Cole).

Next steps:
1) Pick an option and reply to this thread.
2) If you pick Option A, sign the addendum/PO and we'll apply the credit to your first invoice.
3) If Option B, we will provision the token top-up and start the 45-day extension immediately.

I've cc'ed Laura and Rafael for transparency. Marissa will follow up with the milestone plan in a separate note.

Best,
Connor Obrien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.com
Attachments: mpa-addendum-draft.pdf
